intro: Some -ir verbs change a vowel in the indefinido, but only with él and ellos.
p.pidió.consejo: Pedir changes e to i only with él and ellos: «pidió», «pidieron». With yo it is «pedí».
p.pidieron.consejo: Ellos change too: «pidieron». With vosotros it does not change: «pedisteis».
p.durmió.consejo: Dormir changes o to u with él and ellos: «durmió». With yo it is «dormí».
p.murió.consejo: Morir changes like dormir: «murió», «murieron». With yo it would be «morí».
p.nació.consejo: It is common in biographies: «nació en Cuba». In Spain the c sounds like «th».
p.leyó.consejo: An i between vowels becomes y: «leyó», «leyeron». With yo it is «leí», with an accent.
p.oyó.consejo: Oír changes like leer: «oyó», «oyeron». With yo it is «oí».
p.se divirtieron.consejo: Divertirse changes e to i with ellos. The «se» goes before the verb.
p.prefirió.consejo: Preferir changes like pedir: «prefirió», «prefirieron». With yo it is «preferí».
p.el abuelo.consejo: It is masculine: «el abuelo». In the plural, «los abuelos» usually includes the grandmother too.
p.la novela.consejo: It is feminine: «una novela interesante». It is written with v, although it sounds like b.
p.un café.consejo: It has an accent on the e: «café». It means the drink and also the place.
p.la noticia.consejo: It is feminine: «una noticia buena». In the plural, «las noticias» can mean the news bulletin.
b1.texto:
Some **-ir** verbs change their vowel in the indefinido, but **only** with **él/ella/usted** and **ellos/ellas/ustedes**.

- **e → i**: pedir → **pidió**, **pidieron**. Same: preferir, sentir, repetir, servir, divertirse.
- **o → u**: dormir → **durmió**, **durmieron**; morir → **murió**, **murieron**.

With **yo, tú, nosotros and vosotros** nothing changes: **pedí, pediste, pedimos, pedisteis**.

If the stem ends in a vowel, the **i** of the ending becomes **y**: leer → **leyó, leyeron**; oír → **oyó, oyeron**.

Biographies use this tense: **nació** en 1950, **murió** en 2010.
b2.f0.texto: My grandfather was born in Cuba and died in Madrid.
b2.f2.texto: He read a novel every week.
b2.f3.texto: Did he prefer the cinema or the novel?
b2.f4.texto: He preferred the novel and always ordered a coffee.
b2.f5.texto: Did he sleep well with so much coffee?
b2.f7.texto: My parents had fun with his stories.
b3.titulo: Verbs that change and things of life
b4.texto:
See which persons change in **pedir** (e → i) and **dormir** (o → u):

- **yo**: pedí, dormí. No change.
- **tú**: pediste, dormiste. No change.
- **él, ella, usted**: **pidió**, **durmió**. Changes.
- **nosotros**: pedimos, dormimos. No change.
- **vosotros**: pedisteis, dormisteis. No change.
- **ellos, ellas, ustedes**: **pidieron**, **durmieron**. Changes.

With **leer**, the **i** between vowels becomes **y** in the same two persons: **leyó**, **leyeron**. In the others the i takes an accent: **leí, leíste, leímos**.

**-er** verbs like volver do not change the vowel: **volvió**.
b4.e1.texto: The boy slept on the sofa.
b4.e2.texto: My grandparents heard the news on the radio.
b5.f0.texto: The rain beat against the windows of the house all night.
b5.f1.texto: Grandfather read an old novel next to the fireplace.
b5.f2.texto: A hot coffee steamed on the wooden table.
b5.f3.texto: The children heard the distant thunder from bed.
b5.f4.texto: A golden light trembled on the white walls.
b5.f5.texto: Sleep slowly reached the tired eyes.
b5.f6.texto: Grandfather slept in his armchair with the book open.
b5.f7.texto: Grandmother turned off the lamp with a gentle hand.
b5.f8.texto: Silence filled the house like a warm blanket.
b5.f9.texto: At dawn the birds sang among the wet trees.
b6.o0.refuerzo: With ellos the o changes to u. It is not «dormieron».
b6.o1.refuerzo: That's it! With él and ellos, o becomes u.
b6.pregunta: Which form of dormir goes with «ellos»?
b7.o0.refuerzo: With ella the e changes to i: «pidió». «Pedió» does not exist.
b7.o1.refuerzo: Good: ella is the third person and e becomes i.
b7.o2.refuerzo: «Pedí» is the yo form, not my sister's.
b7.pregunta: Which form of pedir completes the sentence?
b8.traduccion: My grandfather was born in Cuba
b9.o0.refuerzo: Yes: -er verbs like volver do not change the vowel.
b9.o1.refuerzo: It is well written, but dormir does change. The question asks for the form that does not.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Wrongly written: pedir changes and it is «pidió».
b10.frase: Los niños ____ la noticia en la radio.
b10.o0.refuerzo: «Oyó» is for one person. Here there are several children.
b10.o1.refuerzo: Between vowels the i becomes y: it is not written «oyieron».
b10.o2.refuerzo: Well done! Plural, with y between the two vowels.
b10.pregunta: Which form of oír goes with «los niños»?
b12.o0.refuerzo: That form does not exist: morir gives «murió».
b12.o1.refuerzo: Correct: the o of morir becomes u with él.
b12.o2.refuerzo: With él the o changes to u. «Morió» does not exist.
p.novelas.consejo: Plural of «novela», feminine. The v sounds b: no-BE-las.
p.historias.consejo: It means both «stories» and «history». The h is silent and «ia» is one syllable: is-TO-ryas.
p.cafés.consejo: Plural of «café»: add -es and the accent stays: «cafés». The stress is on the last syllable.
p.oyeron.consejo: The i between vowels becomes y: «oyeron», never «oyieron». Singular: «oyó».
p.chimenea.consejo: Two strong vowels, e and a, are in different syllables: chi-me-NE-a. The ch sounds like in «chocolate».
p.humeó.consejo: It comes from «humo» (smoke). The h is silent; e and o are two syllables: u-me-O.
p.truenos.consejo: The singular «trueno» is also used: «un trueno». «Ue» is one syllable: TRWE-nos.
p.lejanos.consejo: It agrees with «truenos»: masculine plural. The j sounds like a strong h.
p.tembló.consejo: Past of «él» in -ar verbs: -ó, with an accent. In the present «temblar» changes: «tiembla».
p.paredes.consejo: It is feminine: «la pared», «las paredes». The singular ends in -d; the plural adds -es.
p.llegó.consejo: Past of «él» in -ar verbs: -ó. The ll sounds y and the g is hard: ye-GO.
p.cansados.consejo: It comes from «cansar». It agrees with «ojos»: masculine plural. The d between vowels is soft.
p.apagó.consejo: The opposite of «encender». The g is hard and the accent marks the last syllable: a-pa-GO.
p.tibia.consejo: It agrees with «manta»: feminine. The masculine is «tibio». The v of «ia» is not written: it is a b, TI-bya.
p.cantaron.consejo: Past of «ellos» in -ar verbs: -aron, with no accent. Compare the future «cantarán», with an accent.
p.mojados.consejo: It agrees with «árboles»: masculine plural. It comes from «mojar», and the j sounds like a strong h.
p.durmieron.consejo: With «ellos», the o of «dormir» becomes u: «durmieron», not «dormieron».
p.volvió.consejo: The verbs in -er like «volver» do not change the vowel in the past: «volvió». Both v sound b.
